title: One feature for the volunteer portal

walkthroughIntro.inOneLine: Agree what matters, score every option on the same scale, and check whether the ranking survives uncertain assumptions.
walkthroughIntro.bestFor: Several feasible options that need comparison against agreed criteria.
walkthroughIntro.howLong: 26 minutes for 2–6 participants; also available solo.
walkthroughIntro.origin: An independently written workflow using a widely known thinking method. Instructions and fictional examples were created for this app; no third-party endorsement is claimed.

lenses.name: Define criteria and weights
lenses.instruction: Propose measurable criteria and weights that total 100. Define a 1-to-5 scale for each: 1 is least desirable and 5 most desirable. Keep cost direction explicit. Agree the shared criteria and anchors before the next round.

lenses.name: Check comparable options
lenses.instruction: List the feasible options against the agreed constraints. Note missing facts for each option and assumptions that could make a comparison unfair. Confirm the same option labels for everyone.

lenses.name: Score, calculate and challenge
lenses.instruction: Record a row per option: criterion scores from 1 to 5, evidence or assumption for each score, and total = sum(weight × score) / 100. Use the agreed weights. Compare totals, then recalculate under one plausible changed score or weight. Record arithmetic in your answer.
